title: Product Operations Basics
mission: Learn the basic vocabulary and expressions used in product operations.

expression.text: Let me introduce our product.
expression.translation: 让我介绍一下我们的产品。

script: Hi, I'm responsible for product operations. Our product helps users work more efficiently.

challenge.text: Introduce yourself and your product operations role.
challenge.translation: 用英文介绍你自己以及你的产品运营工作。

title: Talk About Your Job
mission: Learn how to introduce your job and responsibilities.

expression.text: I manage projects and support product teams.
expression.translation: 我负责管理项目，并支持产品团队。

script: I'm a product operations manager. I work with different teams and support product growth.

challenge.text: Introduce your job in three sentences.
challenge.translation: 用三句话介绍你的工作。

title: Describe Your Daily Work
mission: Learn how to explain your daily work tasks.

expression.text: I usually prepare reports and join meetings every day.
expression.translation: 我通常每天准备报告并参加会议。

script: Every morning, I check my schedule and organize important tasks.

challenge.text: Describe your typical workday.
challenge.translation: 描述你典型的一天工作。

title: Work With Teams
mission: Learn how to communicate with different teams.

expression.text: I work with different teams to solve problems.
expression.translation: 我和不同团队合作解决问题。

script: Good communication helps teams work better.

challenge.text: Explain how you work with your teammates.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何与团队成员合作。

title: Talk About Product Goals
mission: Learn how to discuss product goals and plans.

expression.text: Our goal is to improve the customer experience.
expression.translation: 我们的目标是提升客户体验。

script: We focus on customer needs and improve our product experience.

challenge.text: Talk about one product goal.
challenge.translation: 介绍一个产品目标。

title: Understand User Needs
mission: Learn how to talk about users and their needs.

expression.text: We analyze user feedback to understand their needs.
expression.translation: 我们分析用户反馈来理解他们的需求。

script: Understanding users is important for product success. We collect feedback and analyze user behavior.

challenge.text: Explain how you understand user needs.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何理解用户需求。

title: Discuss Product Features
mission: Learn how to describe product features.

expression.text: This feature helps users complete tasks more efficiently.
expression.translation: 这个功能帮助用户更高效地完成任务。

script: We designed a new feature based on user feedback and plan to launch it soon.

challenge.text: Introduce one product feature.
challenge.translation: 介绍一个产品功能。

title: Manage Product Problems
mission: Learn how to discuss problems and solutions.

expression.text: We need to identify the issue and find a solution.
expression.translation: 我们需要找到问题并寻找解决方案。

script: When problems happen, we analyze the situation and find solutions.

challenge.text: Describe how you solve a work problem.
challenge.translation: 描述你如何解决一个工作问题。

title: Talk About Data
mission: Learn basic workplace English for discussing data.

expression.text: We use data to measure product performance.
expression.translation: 我们使用数据衡量产品表现。

script: Data helps us understand product performance and make better decisions.

challenge.text: Talk about one important metric.
challenge.translation: 介绍一个重要指标。

title: Share Work Updates
mission: Learn how to give professional work updates.

expression.text: Here is the progress update and our next step.
expression.translation: 这是当前进展和我们的下一步计划。

script: I will share the latest progress, discuss priorities, and explain the next steps.

challenge.text: Give a short project update.
challenge.translation: 进行一次简短的项目进展汇报。

title: Join Product Meetings
mission: Learn useful English expressions for product meetings.

expression.text: Let's discuss this topic and make a decision together.
expression.translation: 让我们讨论这个话题并一起做决定。

script: In product meetings, we share opinions, discuss problems, and make decisions together.

challenge.text: Share your opinion in a meeting.
challenge.translation: 在会议中表达你的观点。

title: Explain Product Strategy
mission: Learn how to talk about product strategy.

expression.text: Our strategy focuses on improving user experience.
expression.translation: 我们的策略重点是提升用户体验。

script: A clear product strategy helps teams understand goals and directions.

challenge.text: Explain your product strategy.
challenge.translation: 解释你的产品策略。

title: Work With Stakeholders
mission: Learn how to communicate with important partners.

expression.text: We need to align with stakeholders before moving forward.
expression.translation: 我们需要在推进之前和相关方达成一致。

script: Good communication with stakeholders helps projects move smoothly.

challenge.text: Explain how you work with stakeholders.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何与相关方合作。

title: Handle Customer Feedback
mission: Learn how to respond to customer feedback.

expression.text: We listen to customers and provide better solutions.
expression.translation: 我们倾听客户并提供更好的解决方案。

script: Customer feedback helps us improve products and provide better services.

challenge.text: Describe how you handle feedback.
challenge.translation: 描述你如何处理反馈。

title: Manage Project Progress
mission: Learn how to talk about project management.

expression.text: We track project progress and make sure everything is on schedule.
expression.translation: 我们跟踪项目进展并确保一切按计划进行。

script: Project management requires clear timelines, resources, and communication.

challenge.text: Give a project progress update.
challenge.translation: 汇报项目进展。

title: Prioritize Work Tasks
mission: Learn how to talk about priorities and workload.

expression.text: I need to prioritize my tasks and focus on the most important work.
expression.translation: 我需要安排任务优先级，并专注于最重要的工作。

script: Good prioritization helps teams finish important tasks efficiently.

challenge.text: Explain how you prioritize your work.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何安排工作的优先级。

title: Present Product Results
mission: Learn how to present product results professionally.

expression.text: The project achieved positive results and improved user experience.
expression.translation: 这个项目取得了积极成果，并提升了用户体验。

script: When presenting results, we should explain achievements, data, and business impact.

challenge.text: Present one product achievement.
challenge.translation: 介绍一个产品成果。

title: Discuss Product Improvements
mission: Learn how to talk about improving products.

expression.text: We want to optimize the product and enhance user experience.
expression.translation: 我们希望优化产品并增强用户体验。

script: Product improvements should focus on user needs and business goals.

challenge.text: Describe one product improvement.
challenge.translation: 描述一个产品优化。

title: Work Across Departments
mission: Learn how to communicate across different departments.

expression.text: We collaborate with different departments to deliver better results.
expression.translation: 我们与不同部门合作，以取得更好的结果。

script: Cross-functional collaboration is important for successful projects.

challenge.text: Explain how you collaborate with other teams.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何与其他团队合作。

title: Review Work Experience
mission: Learn how to summarize your professional experience.

expression.text: I have experience in product operations and project management.
expression.translation: 我在产品运营和项目管理方面有经验。

script: My experience helps me solve problems, communicate with teams, and create value.

challenge.text: Introduce your professional experience.
challenge.translation: 介绍你的职业经历。

title: Introduce Your Professional Background
mission: Learn how to introduce your role and professional experience.

expression.text: I work in product operations and manage daily business tasks.
expression.translation: 我从事产品运营工作，负责日常业务工作。

script: I have experience in product operations. My role is to support products, users, and business teams.

challenge.text: Introduce yourself as a product operations professional.
challenge.translation: 以产品运营从业者身份介绍自己。

title: Explain Your Work Responsibilities
mission: Learn how to describe your daily responsibilities.

expression.text: I coordinate teams and make sure projects move forward.
expression.translation: 我协调团队并确保项目持续推进。

script: My daily work includes coordinating teams, solving problems, and supporting product growth.

challenge.text: Explain your main work responsibilities.
challenge.translation: 介绍你的主要工作职责。

title: Communicate Across Teams
mission: Learn how to work with different teams.

expression.text: I work with different teams to align goals and priorities.
expression.translation: 我和不同团队合作，确保目标和优先级一致。

script: Product operations requires communication with product, engineering, and business teams.

challenge.text: Describe how you collaborate with other teams.
challenge.translation: 描述你如何与其他团队合作。

title: Report Product Performance
mission: Learn how to talk about data and business results.

expression.text: We use metrics to understand product performance.
expression.translation: 我们通过指标了解产品表现。

script: I analyze data and share results with teams to support better decisions.

challenge.text: Give a short product performance update.
challenge.translation: 进行一次简短的产品表现汇报。

title: Manage Product Launches
mission: Learn English for product launch communication.

expression.text: We prepare the launch plan and collect user feedback.
expression.translation: 我们准备上线计划并收集用户反馈。

script: Before a product launch, teams need to prepare plans, test features, and collect feedback.

challenge.text: Explain how you prepare a product launch.
challenge.translation: 解释你如何准备产品上线。
